items.title: Safely scaling multi-agent teams with Claude Fable 5.2 / claude.dev Blog
items.summary: Multi-agent teams can solve challenging, long-horizon problems. In September, we published the first end-to-end formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem, written by dozens of agents running an internal research model roughly comparable to Claude Fable 5.1.
